name: Watabe Tomoaki
source:
A Niconiya web reporter who became famous by charging into crime scenes for scoops and obtaining never-before-seen photos for his reports.

[Spoiler]Died by swallowing high amounts of Sumo Stickers on October 10th, becoming the 4th victim in the Return of the New Generation Madness cases.[/spoiler]
